arguments.sql:
WITH powers AS (
  SELECT hero_id, COUNT(power_id) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS powers
  FROM main.hero_power GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT g.gender, COUNT(*) AS population, COUNT(p.hero_id) AS with_records,
       SUM(h.full_name IS NULL) AS null_names, SUM(TRIM(h.full_name) = '') AS blank_names,
       SUM(INSTR(TRIM(h.full_name), ' ') > 0) AS multipart_names,
       SUM(CASE WHEN INSTR(TRIM(h.full_name), ' ') > 0 AND p.hero_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multipart_with_records,
       SUM(p.records - p.powers) AS repeated_powers
FROM main.superhero AS h JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
LEFT JOIN powers AS p ON p.hero_id = h.id
GROUP BY g.gender

arguments.sql:
WITH hero_counts AS (
    SELECT h.id, g.gender, COUNT(p.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS h
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN main.hero_power AS p ON p.hero_id = h.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND INSTR(TRIM(h.full_name), ' ') > 0
    GROUP BY h.id, g.gender
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN power_count END), 2) AS male_average,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN power_count END), 2) AS female_average
FROM hero_counts
LIMIT 1
